output.answer: SpaceX's IPO has already happened: the company priced its initial public offering of 555,555,555 Class A shares at $135.00 per share on June 11, 2026, and the stock began trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market (dually listed on Nasdaq Texas) under the ticker "SPCX" on June 12, 2026. The offering — the largest IPO in history, aiming to raise about $75 billion and valuing SpaceX at roughly $1.75 trillion — was expected to close on June 15, 2026. So there is no upcoming IPO date to wait for; SpaceX has been publicly traded since June 12, 2026.
caveats: The June 12, 2026 trading start and June 15, 2026 offering close were stated as 'expected' in SpaceX's pricing announcement; the closing remained subject to customary closing conditions.
The $1.75 trillion valuation was the deal's target valuation at pricing; SpaceX's actual market value after listing fluctuates with the share price and is not fixed by these figures.
This answer covers Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SpaceX) only; no separate Starlink IPO has occurred — Starlink was part of SpaceX's offering.

passages.quote: STARBASE, Texas - Space Exploration Technologies Corp. ("SpaceX") today confirmed the pricing of its initial public offering of 555,555,555 shares of its Class A common stock, at a public offering price of $135.00 per share.

The shares are expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market and Nasdaq Texas on June 12, 2026, under the ticker symbol "SPCX." The offering is expected to close on June 15, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.

SpaceX publicly set a $135 price for shares in its initial public offering on Wednesday... The company is aiming to raise $75 billion, the most ever for an IPO, in a deal that would value it at $1.75 trillion

Space Exploration Technologies Corp. - Class A common stock is expected to be listed and begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market and be dually listed on Nasdaq Texas under the ticker symbol SPCX.

output.question: When is SpaceX's IPO date?

key_facts.fact: SpaceX priced its IPO on June 11, 2026: 555,555,555 Class A shares at $135.00 per share, plus a 30-day underwriter option for up to 83,333,333 additional shares.
SpaceX shares began trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market and Nasdaq Texas on June 12, 2026, under the ticker symbol "SPCX".
The IPO was expected to close on June 15, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
The IPO aimed to raise $75 billion — the most ever for an IPO — valuing SpaceX at $1.75 trillion.
SpaceX launched its IPO roadshow on June 4, 2026, with the IPO price expected to be $135.00 per share.
The SEC declared SpaceX's registration statement effective on June 11, 2026; Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, BofA, Citigroup and J.P. Morgan led the book-running managers.
